text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After we win several races, Super<n>Creek begins
receiving various<n>offers.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Magazine interviews, advertisements,<n>and even
cameos on TV. Our days are<n>filled to the brim just
trying to stay on<n>top of all the requests, until...
choice_data_list: Looks like things are finally settling down.
Looks like things are finally settling down.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Indeed. We can rest for a bit at last.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
This is the perfect opportunity to go to<n>a hot spring!
What do you say? We<n>can use the coupon I got at
that raffle.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, we promised to go on a hot<n>spring trip
once things calmed down.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Our break starts tomorrow, so this is<n>the perfect
opportunity, don't you<n>think?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next day, Super Creek<n>and I head to the
hot spring inn.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, this place is so charming!
choice_data_list:
Apparently, it's famous enough to get featured in
magazines.

Apparently, it's famous enough to get featured in
magazines.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now I'm even more excited! ♪ Let's<n>go.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: We enter the inn with high<n>expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew, that felt great! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Your skin is so smooth now! And you<n>look really
happy too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's head over to your<n>room.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's not every day that we're able to<n>go on a hot
spring trip. You need to<n>relax and enjoy yourself to
the<n>fullest! ♪
Here you go! Say, "Ahh." ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't that tasty? ♪ Next up is some
wild-vegetable tempura.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything else you want to<n>eat? Keep the
requests coming! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It looks like your shoulders are all<n>loosened up
now. On to your arms<n>and legs...

Is that enough pressure? I'll<n>massage all the way
to your<n>fingertips! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
After your massage comes the ear<n>cleaning! Come
and rest your head<n>on my lap! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Does that feel good?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so I receive a full-course<n>pampering from
Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... I'm so glad we took this hot<n>spring trip! ♪
choice_data_list: You should rest a bit as well.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I've rested plenty!
Pampering you is how I recharge! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And it's also my way of saying thank<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You stuck by my side during the<n>Arima Kinen and
the whole time<n>before that as well, so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I wanted to show you how grateful I<n>am! ♪
choice_data_list:
If that's the case, then do it to your heart's
content!

If that's the case, then do it to your heart's
content!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You bet I will! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We're back to our usual schedule<n>starting from
tomorrow, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let me spoil you like this from time to<n>time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Super Creek and I have<n>formed an
unbreakable bond during<n>this time together.
